name: Stumblepup
ability: Liquid Courage / Friend Guard / Tangled Feet (hidden)
look: a scruffy Saint Bernard puppy with rosy cheeks, droopy ears and a tiny wooden keg on its collar
entry: Trained to rescue lost hikers in snowy passes, Stumblepup carries a warming tonic in its neck barrel—though it often spills half of it tripping over its own paws.
how: Wild: common in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Evolves into Tavern Hound at level 30.
